name: @amartinr/pi-bifrost-reasoning-fix
description: Pi extension that fixes the DeepSeek-behind-Bifrost reasoning drop on tool-calling turns. Bifrost relays DeepSeek reasoning in non-standard fields (reasoning / reasoning_details instead of reasoning_content); in tool-calling contexts DeepSeek requires reasoning_content to be passed back, so Bifrost stops reasoning once the history contains tool calls. This extension normalizes the provider request payload (inlet) so replayed history carries DeepSeek's reasoning_content.
author: A. Martin <abel.martin.ruiz@gmail.com>
